name: Noise Complaints
summary: Knaz Blunderflame asks you to deal with ogres snooping near his noisy work at Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount. Their presence threatens the peace he needs to pursue his Mirage Raceway dream.

sections.title: Ogres Nearby
sections.body: Knaz Blunderflame works on a contraption for the Mirage Raceway Championships, and the noise has drawn unwanted attention. He has seen an ogre watching from behind a tree. Now you are asked to stop the Mosh'Ogg ogres near the mount before they bring danger to the place.

faq.answer: Knaz Blunderflame asks you to stop the Mosh'Ogg ogres snooping near his work.
Knaz saw an ogre peeking from behind a tree near his work, but he does not know why they are watching.
Knaz is building a contraption for the Mirage Raceway Championships.
The Mosh'Ogg ogres are near Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
Knaz's late-night tinkering makes a great deal of noise, and his neighbor fears being mauled by the ogres.
